messages:
Rae: Opening a compact PR to add an on-prem runbook appendix: focused checklist for network, KMS/HSM mapping, air-gap verify steps, and a tiny systemd example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4418. Requesting eng-runtime + security reviews.
Omar: Nice. Can we include the exact `iptables`/`nft` snippets we hand to customers and a one-liner to check conntrack?
Rae: Yep — adding both. Will also include a short note about deterministic PKCS#11 mapping and a sample YAML map.
Sofia: Please include the offline bundle verification steps we use in QA: `sha256sum` and `gpg --verify` examples, and mention clock skew as a common failure.
Rae: Draft snippets: ```bash
# control-plane quick check
curl -sSf --retry 2 https://{{ REDWOOD_API_HOST }}/v1/health || echo "control-plane unreachable"
# conntrack dump for control-plane IP
sudo conntrack -L | grep {{ REDWOOD_API_HOST }} || true
# nftables masquerade example
nft add table ip rwinf_nat; nft add chain ip rwinf_nat postrouting '{ type nat hook postrouting priority 100; }'; nft add rule ip rwinf_nat postrouting ip saddr 10.11.0.0/16 oifname "eth0" masquerade
```
Omar: For HSM: include `pkcs11-tool --list-slots` example and recommend storing token serial+label in the map; slot indices can change after firmware updates.
Rae: Adding YAML map example: ```yaml
# hsm_key_map.yaml
keys:
  - alias: redwood-root
    token_serial: "SN-2026-01"
    label: REDWOOD_ROOT
    preferred_slot: 1
```
Sofia: Add a tiny systemd unit for the offline installer and mention SELinux labels for `/opt/redwood` and `/etc/redwood/keys`.
Rae: Systemd snippet added: ```ini
[Unit]
Description=Redwood Offline Installer
After=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-offline-install --bundle /opt/redwood/offline/redwood-offline-2026.03.22.tar.gz
RemainAfterExit=yes
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
docs-bot: Linkcheck: /private/onprem#hsm-map -> 404, suggestion: /private/onprem#hsm-mapping. Ran at 2026-03-22T16:40Z.
eng-runtime: Quick perf note: mention reducing default KV cache retention to 128MB on small sealed nodes. Add a short line in the appendix.
security: Please add a short paragraph about verifying PKCS#11 module integrity (sha256 of module + permissions) and recommend `chmod 640` for `/etc/redwood/keys`.
Rae: Added module checksum check and perms guidance. Also included the verification commands from Sofia and a one-line troubleshooting checklist: DNS, CA bundle, NTP, PKCS#11 slot.
Omar: Tiny wording nit: prefer `{{ REDWOOD_API_HOST }}` placeholders rather than absolute hosts in examples. Also LGTM after the anchor fix from docs-bot.
Rae: Thanks — fixing anchor and merging after eng-runtime + security approve. I'll post a short note in #eng-docs when it lands. :rocket:
